messages.subject: source()$value vs ui function call
parts:
Hi everyone,
quick question in terms of best practices.. (other than using modules, as in this case I just need some UI elements created for user input to be passed onto markdown). If I want to partition the ui.R, two things come to mind:

Option 1: Source with $value. In this case myfile.R just contains tagList(...).

source("myfile.R, local = TRUE)$value

Option 2. Source the file and assign function calls to each ui element

source("myfile.R, local = TRUE)

then inside myfile.R

uielements <- function(){
tagList (....)
}

and ui.R just calls uielements() in the right spot.

It seems both are giving the same ui output and working fine, just curious if there's a preferred way of splitting ui code or if any of those two methods have any unintended consequences...

Thanks!
